messages:
pat: Heads-up  starting relnotes draft for Monday publish. Need 3 whats-new bullets, SDK snippet updates, and a small known-issues list. Who can take items?

rina: Ill write the bullets. Keep them customer-first (benefit then feature).

sam: Ill update examples. Will change `create_completion` -> `responses.create()` and add streaming `client.responses.stream()` samples in Python and JS.

lee: Ill collect known issues and repro steps. Current two: embeddings drift over 1024 tokens, and occasional eu-west fallback latency.

pat: Rina, keep each bullet <= 2 lines. Sam, include a short migration note: remove `on_token` callbacks.

sam: Python streaming draft: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model="kestrel-3", prompt="Short summary"):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

rina: Bullets pushed to PR #840: 1) Lower latency streaming for short replies; 2) Improved embed profiles for dense search; 3) SDK migration notes for v1.

devrel-bot: Preview build ready: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood.ai/relnotes-2114445555 (build 537) :white_check_mark:

lee: Known-issues draft: "Embeddings may degrade for inputs >1024 tokens. Workaround: truncate inputs or pin quantization to `q4_0`." And: "eu-west model fallback can add ~300ms cold-starts; pin `region` in route config for critical paths."

pat: Run link checker for old SDK paths. If broken, replace `docs.redwood.ai/sdk` -> `docs.redwood.ai/sdk/v1`.

sam: Running link check now. Will merge snippets after preview green.

pat: Target merge by 11pm PT. If anything blocks, ping me. Thanks!
